history.body: Hi, saw the Pearl Residences ad. We already have our own place, but we’re curious about this project. Could you share a bit about it?

Sure — Pearl Residences is a freehold residential condominium in Seberang Jaya. The main Phase 1 layout is 900 sq. ft., with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. Since you already have your own place, are you looking at this as an investment, a second home for someone, or just exploring for now?

Possibly as a long-term rental investment. We already have our own place, so we’d want to understand the likely ongoing costs and whether there’s a realistic rental market, but we’re just exploring for now.

For the 900 sq. ft. Phase 1 layout, maintenance is RM0.18 per sq. ft. inclusive of sinking fund—about RM162 a month. That’s the verified recurring project charge I can share; I don’t have other ownership costs confirmed. I don’t want to guess at rents, so I’ll check current comparable rental evidence in Seberang Jaya to help you judge whether the numbers could make sense.
Thanks, the maintenance figure is useful, but without comparable rental information I can’t assess whether it makes sense as an investment. Please share what you can confirm when it’s available.

Understood—without comparable rents, we can’t responsibly assess whether the investment makes sense. The rental comparison is already being checked, and I’ll share only what can be verified once it’s available. Meanwhile, I can confirm Pearl Residences is freehold in Seberang Jaya, with Phase 1 expected to be completed in Q4 2029.
